Introduction
Spatial Training Room is an automated data factory that converts a 3D indoor reconstruction (Gaussian Splatting scene) + per-object AABB annotations + room polygon maps into Active Perception Learning (APL) training samples. Each sample is a 4D question: (init_view, expert_action_sequence, target_view, question, answer). The initial viewpoint is deliberately selected so the question is unanswerable— the agent must actively navigate (pan, tilt, translate) to gather sufficient visual evidence before answering. The 19 active task templates cover spatial reasoning across occlusion, cross-room, counting, configuration, distance, and navigability.
